description: This file contains the implementation of a Watchdog class that monitors runtime and component health in an Orleans silo environment. It periodically checks system health, logs warnings if stalls or issues are detected, and manages background threads for health monitoring.

classes.name: Watchdog
classes.description: A class that monitors system and component health periodically using background threads, logs issues, and exposes start and stop functionalities.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the watchdog monitoring threads.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the watchdog monitoring and disposes resources.

methods.name: RunPlatformWatchdog
methods.description: Background thread method that periodically checks system runtime health.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeHealth
methods.description: Performs health checks related to runtime stalls, GC pauses, and timer stalls.

methods.name: RunComponentWatchdog
methods.description: Background thread method that periodically checks health of registered components.

methods.name: CheckComponentHealth
methods.description: Checks the health of registered components and logs failures or complaints.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cancels background threads and releases resources.
